arxiv-2210-00966.title: The geometry of the space of vortices on a two-sphere in the Bradlow limit Thanks: E-mail: j.m.speight@leeds.ac.uk (corresponding author)
arxiv-2210-00966.creator: R.I. García Lara
arxiv-2210-00966.description: Abstract It is proved that the normalized L 2 L^{2} metric on the moduli space of n n -vortices on a two-sphere, endowed with any Riemannian metric, converges uniformly in the Bradlow limit to the Fubini-Study metric. This establishes, in a rigorous setting, a longstanding informal conjecture of Baptista and Manton.

arxiv-2301-08635.title: Supercritical colliding wind binaries Preprint: Leandro Abaroa
arxiv-2301-08635.creator: Leandro Abaroa, Gustavo E. Romero, Pablo Sotomayor
arxiv-2301-08635.description: Abstract Context. Particle-accelerating colliding-wind binaries (PACWBs) are systems that are formed by two massive and hot stars and produce nonthermal radiation. The key elements of these systems are fast winds and the shocks that they create when they collide. Binaries with nonaccreting young pulsars have also been detected as nonthermal emitters, again as a consequence of the wind–wind interaction.

arxiv-2308-00340.title: A short note on cospectral and integral chain graphs for Seidel matrix
arxiv-2308-00340.creator: Santanu Mandal
arxiv-2308-00340.description: Abstract In this brief communication, we investigate the cospectral as well integral chain graphs for Seidel matrix, a key component to study the structural properties of equiangular lines in space. We derive a formula that allows to generate an infinite number of inequivalent chain graphs with identical spectrum. In addition, we obtain a family of Seidel integral chain graphs.

arxiv-2510-00190.title: Automatic Identification of Magnetospheric Regions using Supervised Machine Learning Models
arxiv-2510-00190.creator: Narges Ahmadi, Robert E. Ergun, Xiangning Chu, Alex Chasapis, Victoria Wilder
arxiv-2510-00190.description: Abstract We present an automated approach for identifying magnetospheric regions using supervised machine learning techniques applied to Magnetospheric MultiScale mission data. Our method utilizes ion energy spectra, total magnetic field, total ion temperature, and spacecraft position data to classify five distinct plasma environments: solar wind, magnetosheath, inner magnetosphere, plasma sheet, and lobe regions.

arxiv-2512-08181.title: NEOWISE data and Thermophysical Modeling of 98943 Torifune (2001 CC 21 ) Facilities: IRSA, NEOWISE
arxiv-2512-08181.creator: Edward L. (Ned) Wright, Joseph Masiero, Amy Mainzer
arxiv-2512-08181.description: Abstract I Abstract The Hayabusa2 \sharp flyby target 98943 Torifune (2001 CC 21 ) has an uncertain size based on an uncertain albedo and uncertain absolute magnitude. We have collected all the NEOWISE observations of 2001 CC 21 from Nov2021 through Feb 2024, a total of 132 frames, and analyzed this data to estimate an infrared radiometric diameter.

arxiv-2601-02463.title: Electron temperature relations and the direct N, O, Ne, S and Ar abundances of 49 959 star-forming galaxies in DESI Data Release 2 2026 Electron temperature relations and the direct N, O, Ne, S and Ar abundances of 49 959 star-forming galaxies in DESI Data Release 2 – B
arxiv-2601-02463.creator: D. Scholte, F. Cullen, J. M. Moustakas, H. Zou, A. Saintonge, K. Z. Arellano-Cordova, T. M. Stanton, B. Andrews, J. Sui, J. Aguilar, S. Ahlen, D. Bianchi, D. Brooks, F. J. Castander, T. Cheng, T. Claybaugh, A. de la Macorra, B. Dey, P. Doel, K. Douglass, S. Ferraro, J. E. Forero-Romero, E. Gaztañaga
arxiv-2601-02463.description: Abstract We present the largest direct-method abundance catalogue of galaxies to date, containing measurements of 49 959 star-forming galaxies at z < 0.96 z<0.96 from DESI Data Release 2. By directly measuring electron temperatures across multiple ionization zones, we provide constraints on a number of electron temperature relations finding good consistency with previous literature relations.

arxiv-2602-23722.title: SLA-Aware Distributed LLM Inference Across Device-RAN-Cloud PubID: pubid: Accepted to IEEE INFOCOM Workshops 2026 (6G AI-RAN 2026), Tokyo, Japan. This arXiv version is a preprint / author version.
arxiv-2602-23722.creator: Hariz Yet, Nguyen Thanh Tam, Mao V. Ngo, Lim Yi Shen, Lin Wei, Jihong Park, Binbin Chen, and Tony Q. S. Quek
arxiv-2602-23722.description: Abstract Embodied AI requires sub-second inference near the Radio Access Network (RAN), but deployments span heterogeneous tiers (on-device, RAN-edge, cloud) and must not disrupt real-time baseband processing. We report measurements from a 5G Standalone (SA) AI-RAN testbed using a fixed baseline policy for repeatability.

pmc-10531739.title: Rasch Analysis of the Korean Version of the Tinnitus Handicap Inventory
pmc-10531739.creator: Ga-Young Kim, Young Sang Cho, Ji Hyun An, Jung-Wan Kim, Il Joon Moon
pmc-10531739.description: Tinnitus is the perception of abnormal sounds in the ears or head without external auditory stimulation. While classical test theory is often used in tinnitus questionnaire development, it has limitations in assessing item characteristics. Item response theory (IRT) offers more precise individual ability estimations and identifies key and less important items, making it superior for reliable measurement tools.

pmc-11429448.title: Navigating the Neurobiology of Parkinson’s: The Impact and Potential of α-Synuclein
pmc-11429448.creator: Erlandas Paulėkas, Tadas Vanagas, Saulius Lagunavičius, Evelina Pajėdienė, Kęstutis Petrikonis, Daiva Rastenytė, Masaru Tanaka, Simone Battaglia, Donato Liloia
pmc-11429448.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Parkinson’s disease (PD) is the second most prevalent neurodegenerative disease worldwide; therefore, since its initial description, significant progress has been made, yet a mystery remains regarding its pathogenesis and elusive root cause. The widespread distribution of pathological α-synuclein (αSyn) aggregates throughout the body raises inquiries regarding the etiology, which has prompted several hypotheses, with the most prominent one being αSyn-associated proteinopathy.

pmc-11518502.title: Perspectives on intersectoral collaboration and citizen participation in community-based prevention
pmc-11518502.creator: J M Sonneveld, J E Bruijning, K Jerković-Ćosić, N J de Wit
pmc-11518502.description: BackgroundChallenges in healthcare, such as rising healthcare costs, shortages of healthcare staff, and health disparities, have made many countries focus on intersectoral collaboration (IC) and citizen participation (CP) in community-based prevention (CBP) and health promotion (HP). Previous research on IC and CP has addressed the importance of exchanging perspectives to arrive at a shared vision and ambition.

pmc-12494036.title: Water-flow electric-gating effect on a van der Waals surface
pmc-12494036.creator: Hua Kang, Yang Yue, Jiayu Liang, Xuejun Wang, Dingding Jiang, Hangyan Chen, Yunqi Liu, Qinghong Yuan, Dacheng Wei
pmc-12494036.description: Since the early 19th century, electric effects at fluid-solid interfaces have been widely studied, which primarily originate from migration of ions or their interactions with functional groups on solid surfaces. However, the intrinsic electric effect of moving water molecules on a pristine van der Waals surface has seldom been explored.

pmc-12610489.title: Method to Predict Salt Expansion Deformation in Cement-Stabilized Macadam Under Sulfate Attack Based on Pore Evolution
pmc-12610489.creator: Xiangyu Li, Xuesong Mao, Pei He, Qian Wu
pmc-12610489.description: Cement-stabilized macadam often shows salt expansion deformation under the action of a sulfate attack, and its pore structure determines its ability to accommodate this deformation. In this paper, the influence of the pore structure of cement-stabilized macadam on its macroscopic deformation is analyzed using a single-grain salt expansion deformation test, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and computerized tomography (CT) scanning.

pmc-13299696.title: Psychological Distress and Associated Factors Among High-School Students in Makkah, Saudi Arabia: A Cross-Sectional Study Using the Arabic GHQ-30
pmc-13299696.creator: Arwa Hesham Hashim, Adeel Ahmed Khan, Aalia Akhtar Hayat
pmc-13299696.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? Adolescent mental health problems often begin during the school years, yet many affected students remain unidentified until symptoms become more severe.This study addresses a school-based public health issue by estimating the prevalence of psychological distress among high-school students in Makkah and examining associated demographic, socioeconomic, and behavioral factors. Public health significance—Why is this work of significance to public health?

pmc-13301650.creator: N Van Pouderoijen, M J Mulder, L H G A Hopman, L E Wentrup, J R De Groot, P G Postema, H A Hauer, M J W Gotte, M J B Kemme, C P Allaart
pmc-13301650.description: BackgroundSeveral ablation strategies are available to achieve pulmonary vein isolation (PVI). PVI performed exclusively with very high-power short-duration (vHPSD) radiofrequency (RF) ablation may enhance procedural efficiency compared with conventional ablation-index (AI) (force-power-time)-guided approaches.PurposeTo evaluate procedural efficiency and one-year clinical outcomes of PVI performed exclusively with vHPSD compared with AI-guided ablation in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

pmc-13392889.title: Selective Extraction Process of Niobium and Tantalum from Tin Slag Derived from the Thermal Processing of Cassiterite
pmc-13392889.creator: Darwin Michell Cheje Machaca, Rosario Belen Juyo Salazar, Susan Sofia Flores-Calla, Amilton Barbosa Botelho Junior, Denise Crocce Romano Espinosa, Jorge Alberto Soares Tenório
pmc-13392889.description: The metallurgical industry for niobium and tantalum extraction from secondary resources typically relies on conventional hydrometallurgical processes, based on acid leaching with hydrofluoric acid.
